selection.policy: retain check results and task bindings; omit unrelated copied runtime inventory

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered frame-metric table together with the selected outer and interior bounding boxes.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Parse every exact hollow color-1 frame, compute its interior occupied-cell count and area, and select the first frame maximizing the configured metric.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Crop the input grid at the selected interior bounding box and return that exact subgrid.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The crop coordinates are not fixed by the canvas or frame order: B needs A to resolve the winner from input-dependent counts and areas. Replacing the raw-count winner with the density winner selects a different frame and changes the protected-Racket output.

parametric_work.summary: The default preserves the canonical program byte-for-byte; occupied_density reuses the same parsed frames and exact count/area table but chooses the first maximum ratio by cross multiplication. The adapter supports 2-6 demonstrations and four prefix-stable queries, qualified both settings on seeds 0 and 17 through protected Racket, and includes a substantive 30x30 case.

remaining_failures: Exact-source owner acceptance and training admission remain pending.
Finite authored rivals and seeds do not prove universal rule uniqueness.
report.summary: Built a native raw-count versus occupied-density frame-selection family with an exact canonical default, setting-neutral 2-6-demo curriculum, four sequential queries including 30x30, bounded shortcut audit, native qualification, and replayed protected-Racket causal witness.
